scripts.prepare-assets: mkdir -p assets/vendor && cp node_modules/gsap/dist/gsap.min.js assets/vendor/gsap.min.js && python3 assets/music/generate_bed.py && ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -y -i assets/music/market-evidence-bed.wav -codec:a libmp3lame -b:a 128k assets/music/market-evidence-bed.mp3 && rm assets/music/market-evidence-bed.wav
scripts.check: npm run prepare-assets && npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.73 check
scripts.render: npm run prepare-assets && npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.73 render
